 Order
Record is received.
2. Heard on admission.
The appeal is admitted for hearing.
With the consent of learned counsel for the parties, the matter is heard finally and is decided as below.

3. This appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 has been filed by the appellants/claimants seeking compensation for the death of deceased (Honey Aarse) who died in a motor accident dated 03.11.2022 challenge impugned award dated 08.01.2024 passed by 1st AMACT, Betul in Claim Case No.28/2023 [Smt. Kishori and others Vs. Prakash and others] whereby compensation of Rs.19,18,900/- has been awarded.

sentences.text: By way of this appeal, appellants are seeking enhancement of Rs.4,00,000/- lacs by paying court fee of Rs.10,000/-.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:6677 2 MA-2574-2024 4.
It is submitted that leanred Tribunal was given future prospects only at the rate of 40% whereas it should have been given at the rate of 50%.
This fact being a law point is not disputed by learned Kishori vs Prakash on 10 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/133380613/
1 counsel for the respondent.
No other ground has been prayed by learned counsel for the appellantd.

5. Learned counsel for both parties does not object to the aforesaid calculation, as they both submit that they have separately calculated and if future prospects is raised from 40% to 50% than amount would be Rs.1,29,600/-.

6. After hearing learned counsel for both parties, this Court is of the considered view that less amount of compensation has been awarded and its comes to knowledge that future prospects from 40% to 50% amount of enhancement would be Rs.1,29,600/- and round figure is Rs.1,30,000/-.
7.
With the aforesaid enhancement in the amount of compensation by Rs.1,30,000/- only, the instant appeal is partly allowed.
8. Rate of interest and other terms and conditions shall remain same as held by learned Claims Tribunal.
9. Accordingly, the appeal stands disposed of.
